convertibility_reason: Hedging logic with bidirectional position management and complex position offsetting. While it uses only built-in MT5 functions, the core logic of hedging opposing positions and netting/offsetting them is non-standard and requires careful manual translation to Python.

other_exits: Positions are closed by offsetting/hedging against opposing positions, net profit target closure when hedged pair reaches combined profit threshold

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lot size derived from existing opposing position volume to create balanced hedge; can open same volume as opposite side

custom_logic_notes: This is a hedging EA that opens opposing positions to existing trades. It scans all open positions (including those from other EAs or manual trades), identifies un-hedged positions, and opens an equal-and-opposite hedge. When both sides of a hedge are open, it monitors the combined profit/loss and closes both when a net profit target is reached. The core logic is position-pair management rather than signal-based entry.
python_conversion_notes: The hedging logic requires maintaining a mapping of position pairs (long vs short for same symbol). Unlike signal-based EAs, this EA's entry is triggered by the existence of un-hedged positions rather than indicator signals. Must implement position-pair tracking, net P&L calculation per hedged pair, and simultaneous close of both legs when profit target is hit. No indicator calls needed. Margin check logic must be preserved.
